# Lines in Art

> A children's picture book that invites kids to explore real artworks by Picasso, Matisse, Mondrian, Kandinsky, Van Gogh, Miró, and others through play, observation, and conversation. For ages 3–8. Hardcover, 40 pages. Published by Little Oaknut.

Lines in Art is not an art history book. It does not tell children what to see. A continuous line travels from page to page, entering famous artworks and reappearing in different forms, guiding children on a visual journey. Each double-page spread pairs a real masterpiece with an original illustration that responds to the artwork rather than explaining it. Children are invited to slow down, notice details, and connect what they see to their own ideas and experiences.

The book includes an Art Gallery (artist name, title, date, location for each work), an illustrated glossary of 12 line types, and ends with an open-ended question: "Where can you find lines around you?" It is designed to be re-read — each reading surfaces new details and new conversations.

Received a 5-star review from the Readers' Favorite Annual Book Award Contest. Tested in homes and in classrooms from preschool to first grade.

This is the first book in a planned series exploring the elements of art: line, shape, form, color, space, texture, and value.

## Key facts

- **Title:** Lines in Art
- **Publisher:** Little Oaknut LLC
- **Authors:** Cecilia Colzani (art historian, museum docent) and Kristin Wight (former elementary school teacher, Visual Thinking Strategies practitioner)
- **Illustrator:** Selena Squarzanti (graphic designer and illustrator, Brera Academy of Fine Arts, Milan)
- **Format:** Hardcover, square 8×8 inches, 40 pages, matte laminated cover, soy-based inks
- **Age range:** 3–8 years
- **Language:** English
- **Featured artists:** Picasso, Matisse, Mondrian, Kandinsky, Van Gogh, Miró, and more
- **Status:** Crowdfunding on Kickstarter — launched March 12, 2026; campaign closes April 12, 2026
- **Funding goal:** $15,000 (all-or-nothing)
- **Kickstarter price:** from $27 per copy (early backer pricing)
- **Estimated ship date:** July 2026
- **Ships:** Worldwide
- **Contact:** hello@linesinart.com
